description: This file defines various custom exception classes related to Orleans transaction management, including base and specialized transaction exceptions, with serialization support and specific semantics for different failure scenarios.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionException
classes.description: Base class for all transaction-related exceptions in Orleans, supporting serialization.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionsDisabledException
classes.description: Indicates that transactions are disabled in Orleans configuration.

classes.name: OrleansStartTransactionFailedException
classes.description: Indicates failure to start a transaction.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionOverloadException
classes.description: Signals that the transaction runtime is overloaded.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionInDoubtException
classes.description: Indicates uncertainty whether a transaction has committed, including a transaction ID property.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionAbortedException
classes.description: Represents a transaction that has been aborted, including a TransactionId property.

classes.name: OrleansCascadingAbortException
classes.description: Thrown when a transaction is aborted due to a dependent transaction aborting.

classes.name: OrleansOrphanCallException
classes.description: Indicates a transaction aborted because a method call did not await all pending calls.

classes.name: OrleansReadOnlyViolatedException
classes.description: Indicates a read-only transaction attempted to perform a write.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionServiceNotAvailableException
classes.description: Indicates that the transaction service is not available.

classes.name: OrleansBrokenTransactionLockException
classes.description: Signifies that a transaction was aborted due to a broken lock detection.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionLockUpgradeException
classes.description: Indicates failure to upgrade a lock during a transaction.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionPrepareTimeoutException
classes.description: Indicates that the prepare phase of a transaction timed out.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionTransientFailureException
classes.description: Represents a transient failure in a transaction, suggesting a retry might be possible.

methods.name: GetObjectData
methods.description: Method used for serialization of exception data; overridden in several classes to include custom properties.
